progression.narrative: The performance opens on F#4 and dwells most on F# in Phrase 1. Phrase 6 (1:15.3) introduces D#, centred on D#. Phrase 7 (1:29.1) introduces C#, A#, centred on C#. Phrase 22 (4:38.1) introduces B, centred on C#. The line peaks at B4 (474.4 Hz) at 4:49.9. It closes on F#4, not the tonic (F#4 → F#4 → G#4 → G#4 → F#4 → F#4).
